I'm an AI Automation Engineer specializing in creating seamless workflow solutions that bridge the gap between complex technology and practical business needs.

Hi, I'm Deep H Bhavsar, an AI Automation Engineer based in India. I help businesses leverage the power of AI and automation to streamline operations, reduce costs, and scale efficiently.

With expertise in n8n workflows, RAG systems, and full-stack development, I create end-to-end solutions that transform how organizations work. My startup idea focuses on building an AI platform for automated workflow generation and enterprise private AI using open-source models.

When I'm not building automation systems, you'll find me exploring the latest in AI agents, ComfyUI video generation, and cybersecurity tools from my curated research repository.
